The complaint system is the best system in the game!
20 Oct @ 12:43am
aLL.
I also received a low priority for:
buying wards, dust, and sentries as a support player, and not taking anyone's farm - a pretty fair ban.
And as it happens - it's impossible to appeal such an aspect because we have an excellent system:
- complaints
- ranked matchmaking
- game support
- communication between the community and the developers
- player behavior assessments
in other words, everything that any online game relies on is simply absent from DOTA.

"THANK YOU, VALVE."
19 Oct @ 10:10am
aLL.
As is the case everywhere, if any unfair or illegal restriction of an account's capabilities is imposed, it can be appealed—ABSOLUTELY ANY platform provides this opportunity, if certain points can be clarified, or if there's at least the opportunity to obtain more detailed information about bans, etc.
Actually, I used to get 12,000 orders—now it's 7,000—for what?
Well, look, it's perfectly fair because I don't insult anyone, I don't send anyone anywhere, I don't use vulgar language, and if there's any real reason for toxic dialogue, I simply mute the player.

I asked support—and why exactly? What criteria and keywords in matchmaking were used to cut off my honest communication? To which I received a perfectly logical and natural response—"Valve support staff have no ability to influence ranked games."
